title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring beef skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Warmly Spiced Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a high-quality olive oil

ingredients.name: Uruguayan-Style Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of paprika, garlic powder, and cumin

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best flavor

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together warmly spiced olive oil, Uruguayan-style seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add beef skewers to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread beef skewers onto metal or bamboo skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer skewers to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve skewers with lime wedges and chopped cilantro, if desired.
Cook's note: Make sure to cook the skewers to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare, 160°F (71°C) for medium, and 170°F (77°C) for well-done.
